title: demo-reel flow
description: Declarative demo-video flow. Validated by scripts/validate.mjs — the schema documents editor support; the script is authoritative.

name.description: Flow id. Outputs go to out/<name>/.

title.description: Title card shown for ~1.8s at the start.

subtitle.description: Small line under the title card.

task.description: One-liner for proof.md. Defaults to title.

baseUrl.description: Origin. All goto paths must start with /.

zoom.description: Page zoom percent for framing. Default 90.

font.description: Caption font stack. Default Inter, Arial.

id.description: Stable id. Used by --from and needs.

creates.description: Step creates server-side records. The validator warns when it replays on resume (retakes duplicate).

caption.description: Bottom-center narration shown for this step. Supports ${vars}.

needs.description: Step ids whose effects must exist. Resume rewinds through these transitively.

trigger.description: CSS selector, or text:<label> for text triggers.
